summary: Workflow well-structured for CI/CD (pinned refs, least-privilege permissions, job deps), scripts excellently written (pure functions, proper types, injection for testability). CRITICAL GAPS: workflow lacks required test harness—no `bun test` execution, no act integration, no act-result.txt artifact, no actionlint validation step, no test fixture setup. Task explicitly required "all tests run through act" with output validation; none of this is present. Bash steps lack explicit `set -euo pipefail`. Code quality high (would score 4–5 standalone), but delivery incomplete.
